mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is currently 63 degrees with slight rain near the Verona Public Library, and under a third quarter moon, the space station passes overhead tonight, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has updated its permit requirements for erosion control and stormwater management for any projects disturbing over 4,000 square feet. Additionally, pavement repairs are scheduled for various locations this Monday and Tuesday.
There is plenty to do with live music at Paddy Mac's today, yoga classes at Insight Wellness today, Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory, and ART House 360 events happening tomorrow.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered stopped at an intersection for an extended period.
Today's delicious flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
